svg.aria-label: A metastable failure, or retry storm: a brief overload makes requests slow; clients time out and retry, which adds more load; the server is now busier, so more requests time out and are retried. The loop keeps the system overloaded even after the original spike is gone. Fixes: exponential backoff with jitter, retry budgets, circuit breakers, load shedding and backpressure.
